svg.title: Dev Mondal — workstation, 02:14
svg.desc: A night-time retro computer workstation drawn entirely in text characters: a beige CRT monitor showing a small terminal, a keyboard, a desk lamp throwing warm light across a wooden desk, a window onto a city skyline with the moon.
